designationHistory.name: Salt Plains Wild Life Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Herbert Hoover established the Salt Plains Wild Life Refuge by Executive Order 5314 on March 26, 1930, as a refuge and breeding ground for birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Salt Plains National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

Wikisource: Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940 (renaming federal wildlife refuges; lists originating orders)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Salt Plains National Wildlife Refuge was established March 26, 1930, originally encompassing the majority of the salt flats.
